summary.goal: Build a generic, source-agnostic knowledge extraction pipeline that reads session data from any supported source, extracts the 5-10% that is actual knowledge (decisions, constraints, patterns, gotchas, context), and writes structured markdown topic files to memory/. Two-stage pipeline: deterministic extraction ($0, <100ms) then selective LLM synthesis (one call). Built as packages/mull/ in the monorepo but structured for easy extraction to a standalone repo. Both CLI and programmatic API.
in_scope: Core type system: Zod schemas for SessionData, Nugget, PreExtract, TopicFile, MergeResult, and all intermediate types
Adapter orchestration: SessionAdapter interface, multi-adapter merge by timestamp, cursor-based incremental processing, createAdapter factory
3 built-in generic adapters: trajectory-file (.trajectory.json), relay-jsonl (YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl), transcript (md/jsonl/txt)
Deterministic extraction: entity extraction (compromise.js + tech lexicon), fact extraction (structural from events), topic matching (against memory/), transcript filtering (decision-adjacent only)
LLM synthesis: prompt construction from PreExtract, single Haiku call, structured nugget output parsing, trail decision shortcut, Tier 0 fallback
Topic file system: markdown + YAML frontmatter, slug-based merge, section management (Decisions/Constraints/Patterns/Gotchas/Context), causal links
Index generation: memory/index.md auto-rebuilt from all topic file frontmatter after every write
Pipeline orchestrator: wires stages together, handles incremental processing, idempotency guarantees, dry-run support
Programmatic API: mull(sessionId, opts) → MergeResult, createAdapter(type, config)
Configuration: mull.config.json, package.json mull key, CLI flag overrides, zero-config defaults
out_of_scope: Graph database from causal links (Tier 3 evolution)
Retrieval — mull only writes, search tools read
Any UI — CLI and programmatic API only for core
Real-time event triggers during live sessions (separate epic: mull-integration)

acceptance_criteria.description: mull <session-id> reads session data via adapter, extracts knowledge, writes topic files to memory/
Deterministic extraction runs at $0 cost and <100ms for typical sessions
LLM synthesis makes exactly one API call per session (Claude Haiku default)
Topic files are markdown with YAML frontmatter, organized by topic not session
Running mull twice on the same session produces identical output (idempotent)
Nuggets merge by slug — no duplicates on re-run
memory/index.md is auto-regenerated after every write, reflects reality
mull --dry-run shows extraction results without writing files
Zero-config default: looks for .trajectories/ in cwd, writes to ./memory/
Package has no dependency on plannr, relay SDK, or any project-specific system
Custom adapters can be provided via SessionAdapter interface
Trail decisions from trajectories bypass LLM and map directly to Decision nuggets
Mull never modifies source data — read-only access to all inputs
Every nugget is self-contained — understandable without the original transcript
Causal links between nuggets use slugs (human-readable), not IDs
Without LLM API key, mull still produces value from deterministic extraction alone (Tier 0)
Incremental runs compose: 10 partial runs = 1 full run (cursor-based)
Parallel sessions don't conflict: each writes to topic files using slug-based merge

observations: Two-stage pipeline is the core innovation: 80% deterministic + 20% LLM matches pure-LLM quality at 375-500x lower cost (LoCoMo benchmark)
The pipeline has 8 explicit steps across 2 stages with a clear PreExtract boundary between them
Adapters are the ONLY external interface — core pipeline never reads sources directly
Topic-organized not session-organized: future agent asking 'what about OAuth?' finds ONE file with complete picture
Filesystem IS the database — no SQLite, no Redis, no vector store for core. Any search tool is the query engine.
compromise.js for NLP entity extraction — ~1MB/sec, zero API calls, likely needs custom lexicon for tech terms
gray-matter for YAML frontmatter — lightweight, standard
Spec maps to ~300 lines of core code: extract.ts (~200 lines) + synthesize.ts (~100 lines)
Package structure maps cleanly to standalone repo: zero monorepo dependencies in core
8 invariants in spec section 10 form the test contract
concerns: compromise.js entity extraction quality for technical terms — may need custom lexicon for TypeScript, OAuth, PKCE, etc.
Topic matching confidence thresholds need tuning with real data before they're reliable
Slug collision handling when two sessions produce same-slug nuggets for different topics
filterTranscript heuristics: too aggressive loses context, too loose wastes LLM tokens — needs empirical tuning

architect.portability: Zero dependencies on plannr monorepo — can be extracted to standalone repo

dependencies.compromise: NLP entity extraction (~1MB/sec, zero API calls)

research.basis: LoCoMo benchmark (Snap Research, ACL 2024) — 300+ turn conversations
key_findings: Structured observations beat raw dialogue by 22-66%
Long context alone is worse than selective extraction
File-based memory is competitive at 74% (Letta benchmark)
80% deterministic + 20% LLM matches pure-LLM at 375-500x lower cost

evolution_path.tier_0: Deterministic extraction + TOC (free baseline, always on)
evolution_path.tier_1: + selective LLM synthesis → topic files (~74% LoCoMo, BUILD THIS)
evolution_path.tier_2: + vector embeddings for retrieval (~82%, trigger: >50 topic files)
evolution_path.tier_3: + graph from Caused links (~87%, trigger: multi-hop questions fail)
evolution_path.tier_4: + reranker + timeline anchoring (~91%, trigger: need near-human accuracy)
